Other – 2%{{cite web |url=https://www.gamlahammarbyfotboll.se/aktuellt/nyheter/zlatan-ibrahimovic-investerar-i-aeg-sweden-blir-delagare-i-hammarby-fotboll-ab/|title=Zlatan Ibrahimović investerar i AEG Sweden – blir delägare i Hammarby Fotboll AB|date=27 November 2019|publisher=Hammarby Fotboll|access-date=27 November 2019|language=sv}} | chrtitle = Chairman | chairman = Mattias Fri | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Henrik Rydström]] | league = [[Allsvenskan]] | season = [[2025 Allsvenskan|2025]] | position = [[Allsvenskan]], 2nd of 16 | current = 2026 Hammarby Fotboll season | website = {{URL|www.hammarbyfotboll.se}} | pattern_la1 = _hammarby24h | pattern_b1 = _hammarby24h | pattern_ra1 = _hammarby24h | pattern_sh1 = _whitesides | pattern_so1 = _hammarby24h | leftarm1 = FFFFFF | body1 = FFFFFF | rightarm1 = FFFFFF | shorts1 = 16A452 | socks1 = FFFFFF | pattern_la2 = _hammarby24a | pattern_b2 = _hammarby24a | pattern_ra2 = _hammarby24a | pattern_sh2 = _hammarby24a | pattern_so2 = _hammarby24a | leftarm2 = 36584A | body2 = 36584A | rightarm2 = 36584A | shorts2 = 36584A | socks2 = 36584A | pattern_la3 = | pattern_b3 = | pattern_ra3 = | leftarm3 = | body3 = | rightarm3 = | shorts3 = | socks3 = }} {{Hammarby IF sections}} '''Hammarby Fotboll''', more commonly known as '''Hammarby IF''' or simply '''Hammarby''' ({{IPA|sv|ˈhâmːa(r)ˌbyː}} or, especially locally, {{IPA|sv|-ˌbʏ|}}), is a Swedish professional [[association football|football club]] from [[Stockholm]] founded in 1915. The club plays at [[3Arena (Stockholm)|3 Arena]] in [[Johanneshov]] but was founded in the neighbouring [[Södermalm]] district of [[Stockholm City Centre]], an area that is considered the club's heartland. Competing in Sweden's [[Swedish football league system|first tier]], [[Allsvenskan]],{{cite web|url=https://svenskfotboll.se/allsvenskan/information/?scr=table&ftid=67049 |title=Tabell och resultat – Allsvenskan, herrar |publisher=Svenskfotboll.se |language = sv|access-date=11 January 2017}} Hammarby are placed eighth in the [[all-time Allsvenskan table]],{{cite web |url= https://svenskfotboll.se/allsvenskan/historik/maratontabell/ |title= Maratontabell – Svenskfotboll.se |work=Svenskfotboll|language=sv}} and has won the league once, in 2001. The club has competed in the [[Svenska Cupen]] final five times, winning their first title in 2021. The club's colours are green and white, which are reflected in its crest and kit. Between 1918 and 1978, however, the club played in black-and-yellow striped home shirts, which since often form the club's away colors. Hammarby is known for its vociferous fans. Drawing inspiration from England, in 1970 they introduced [[football chants]] to the Swedish terraces.{{cite news|url=https://www.dn.se/sport/mellanol-och-rebelltakter-sa-startade-laktarsangen-i-sverige-for-50-ar-sedan/|title=Mellanöl och rebelltakter – så startade läktarsången i Sverige för 50 år sedan|newspaper=[[Dagens Nyheter]]|date=27 August 2020|language=sv}}{{cite web|url=https://www.svt.se/kultur/stefan-var-med-och-startade-den-svenska-laktarsangen|title=Stefan var med och startade den första svenska läktarsången|publisher=[[Sveriges Television]]|date=9 September 2020|language=sv}} Hammarby is one of largest football clubs in Europe in terms of the number of active players of all ages – with some 3,500 players in its organisation.{{cite web|url=http://www.gamlahammarbyfotboll.se/aktuellt/nyheter/edvard-blev-nummer-3000-i-bajens-ungdomsled/|title=Edvard blev nummer 3000 i Bajens ungdomsled|work=Hammarby Fotboll|language=sv|access-date=12 February 2018}}{{cite web|url=http://www.hammarbyungdom.se/start/?ID=122475|title=Hammarby IF Ungdom|language=sv|access-date=12 February 2018}}{{cite web|url=https://www.gamlahammarbyfotboll.se/aktuellt/nyheter/over-900-medverkade-vid-tisdagsmotet/|title=Över 900 medverkade vid tisdagsmötet|work=Hammarby Fotboll|language=sv|access-date=12 February 2018}} Hammarby is affiliated with the [[Stockholms Fotbollförbund]] (Stockholm Football Association).{{cite web|url=https://www2.svenskfotboll.se/cuper-och-serier/spelprogramresultat/?feid=7186|title=Kontaktuppgifter och tävlingar – Hammarby IF FF|work=Svensk Fotboll|language=sv|access-date=27 November 2019}}"}}
